definitions.explanation: The later part of the day, typically from after work/school until bedtime.

examples.japanese: {晩|ばん}ごはんは{何|なに}ですか？
{毎晩|まいばん}{本|ほん}を{読|よ}みます。
examples.english: I read a book every evening.

examples.japanese: {今晩|こんばん}、{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ませんか？
examples.english: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?

notes: Similar to {夜|よる} but often emphasizes the social evening time. Compounds: {晩|ばん}ごはん (dinner), {毎晩|まいばん} (every evening), {今晩|こんばん} (this evening/tonight).
